ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Based on the given diagram, the population of which organism would increase drastically if all the sharks were removed?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a marine food web diagram, containing organisms such as Sun, Phytoplankton, Zoo Plankton, Small Fish, Otter, Shark, Crab, etc. Arrow examples show Sun pointing to Phytoplankton, Phytoplankton pointing to Zoo Plankton, Zoo Plankton pointing to Small Fish, and Small Fish pointing to Otter, indicating that the arrows point to the consumers that obtain food or energy. There is also an arrow in the diagram from Otter pointing to Shark, with the arrowhead at Shark. Reasoning: Because the arrows point to consumers, Otter pointing to Shark means Shark preys on Otter. If all Shark are removed, Otter loses its main predator, and its number will increase greatly. Therefore, the answer is Otter.
